notes: Drive Health: show the real drive identity for NVMe SSDs read through a USB enclosure. When the tool reads a drive's SMART through a USB-to-NVMe bridge, it now also fetches the NVMe Identify Controller page over the same bridge, so the card shows the drive's true model number, serial and firmware instead of the enclosure's placeholders (e.g. the real 'KBG40ZNS256G' and serial rather than a generic 'USB3.1 NVME&SATA SCSI Disk Device' with an all-zero serial). Helps with identifying the exact drive for parts/replacement. Health reading is unchanged — this is identity only.
